proposed_concrete: PER-MMN-004 (alternative placement, maintainer to decide): somatosensory (vibrotactile) oddball MMN (Kekoni et al. 1997, doi:10.1016/S0301-0511(97)05249-6), instead of the new class PER-SMMN
reason: Built as a separate class PER-SMMN following the PER-VMMN precedent (D-041: different sensory channel -> different marker/generator -> different class). If draft D-060 (stimulus-modality change = criterion 2 within a class; modality change never creates a class) is confirmed and applied to the MMN family, PER-SMMN-001 should move to PER-MMN-004 (criterion 2) and PER-VMMN would need the same review.

proposed_concrete: STM-SEP-002 and STM-SEP-003 (alternative placement, maintainer to decide): mechanical tap SEP (Larsson & Prevec 1970) and air-jet SEP (Schieppati & Ducati 1984), instead of the new class STM-TACEP
reason: Built as a separate class STM-TACEP because the stimulus excites cutaneous mechanoreceptors without current and the marker profile differs (N140/P50 rather than the N20 of median-nerve stimulation). If D-060 is applied (stimulus type = criterion 2, same class), these become STM-SEP concrete paradigms.
